result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Customer receives a 30-day termination-for-convenience right, prepaid Fees attributable to the post-termination period are refunded, no early-termination fee applies, and Vendor receives no convenience right. Existing cause-based termination rights and Order Form separability provisions are preserved. However, “in whole or in part” arguably creates an unnecessary and potentially ambiguous right to terminate only portions of the Agreement or an Order Form, exceeding the stated playbook requirement. Otherwise, the drafting is professional, though expressly stating that the refund is pro rata would track the playbook more precisely.
